title: StationBreak channel rules, format version 1
description: Describes a version 1 rules file. Every object is open: a reader keeps and ignores fields it does not know. The schema checks shapes only. The range of a seed (at most 18446744073709551615) and 'to' not below 'from' in a year range are checked by readers; see docs/rules-format.md.

formatVersion.description: 1 for this version. A reader that supports a lower number than this one must not schedule the channel.

name.description: Display name. Free text, 1 to 100 Unicode code points, never used for matching or ordering.

sources.description: What can air. The union of all sources, minus the exclusions.

exclusions.description: What must not air. Same kinds as sources.

id.description: A canonical item ID: 32 lowercase hex characters, no hyphens.

text.description: A name matched exactly, as UTF-8, with ASCII-only case folding.

seed.description: An unsigned 64-bit value as a decimal string: no sign, no leading zeros except "0", at most 20 digits. The range is checked by readers.

rating.description: A rating ceiling, spelled exactly as in the ladder. Absent means no ceiling.

source.description: One source or exclusion, chosen by its 'type'.

fillerSource.description: Where filler comes from: a library, a collection or a tag.

timing.description: Required, because the broadcast-day offset has no default: the creator picks the zone's standard (non-daylight-saving) offset.

alignToGrid.description: Start blocks on the grid marks (gridMinutes). Default false: a run starts when the previous one ends.

epochHours.description: Length of an epoch in hours; must divide 24. Default 24.

minRuntimeSeconds.description: The shortest runtime, in seconds, that counts as a program: an item shorter than this is left out of every epoch's pool. Default 60.

graceHours.description: Grace window G in hours: an item joins epoch n only if it was added before the epoch's start minus G. Default 6.

gridMinutes.description: Grid spacing in minutes. Default 30. With 60, broadcastDay.start must be on the hour.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: Fixed offset from UTC in minutes, east positive, a multiple of 15. Required: no default. Use the zone's standard (non-daylight-saving) offset.

start.description: When the broadcast day starts, as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock at that offset, on the hour or half hour. Default 06:00.

every.description: N for betweenEveryN: one filler item after every N programs.
